content:
The official Prime Day 2026 sale is now flying and the AirPods deals are too. The new 2026 AirPods Max 2 are now sitting down at a wild $150 off the list price in all five colors while AirPods Pro 3 are nearly 30% off and we are still tracking AirPods 4 down at $99 shipped.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 from $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 from $399 (Reg. $549)

Plus, here’s a bonus deal for you: We’re also tracking Apple’s AirTag 2 item trackers at their best-ever price:

  • AirTag (1-pack) $24 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99)

Head below for the full details on the best AirPods deals for Prime Day …

AirPods Pro 3

The official Amazon Prime Day deal on AirPods Pro 3 has arrived down at $179 shipped. While there is still a chance we see the short-lived $169 deal return, we are only talking another $10 off here and the second-best deal we have ever tracked anywhere. Regularly $249, this is just shy of 30% off the list price and a solid opportunity to land a set for the summer and beyond.

Full review: AirPods Pro 3 review: The best get even better

AirPods Max 2

Perhaps one of the most impressive Prime Day deals we have tracked thus far, Amazon is now offering a giant $150 off AirPods Max 2 right now. The 2026 Apple release carries all-new tech and the same $549 list price as last go around, buy you can bring a set home down at the $399 all-time low – that’s $150 off and the best deal we have ever tracked on the premium Apple over-ears.

  • AirPods Max 2 $399 (Reg. $549) – New all-time low

Full review: AirPods Max 2 review: High-end adds modern features at last

AirPods 4

While the AirPods 4 aren’t wildly low prices for Prime Day just yet, we are still seeing both the base model set and the upgraded ANC variant with discounts starting from $99 shipped. The base set is now matching the lowest price of the year at Amazon while the ANC set is sitting with a more modest price drop down at $149 shipped.

  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $149 (Reg. $179)

Full review: Hands-on with AirPods 4: better in every way

Beats deals at Best Buy

Meanwhile over at Best Buy, we’re tracking some stellar deals on Apple’s Beats lineup. Here are some of our favorites:

  • Beats Pill (brand new): $99.99
  • Powerbeats Pro 2: $200 (Reg. $250)
  • Beats Studio Buds Plus Transparent $89.99 (Reg. $170)
  • Beats Solo 4 Wireless On-Ear Headphones $100 (Reg. $200)
  • Beats Solo Buds Earbuds Transparent Red (Open-Box Excellent) $43 (Reg. $80)
  • Beats Solo Buds $70 (Reg. $80)
  • Beats Studio Pro Headphones (Brand new): from $149.99
    • Also matched at Amazon but the Matte White set is now at the $132.50 Prime Day all-time low
  • Beats Studio Pro ANC Headphones Navy (Open-Box Excellent): $118.99
  • Beats Studio Pro ANC Headphones Black/Gold (Open-Box Excellent): $128.99
